description:
Dynamics 365 /Power Platform Developer   

 Microsoft Dynamics 365 • Power Platform • Configuration & Development • Tier III Support   

 Location: Remote / Contractor Site, with occasional in-person meetings or workshops as required   

 Clearance: Must be a US Citizen, Ability to obtain a DHS clearance required; current DHS clearance preferred.     

 Work Status : Remote   

 A Role with Purpose and Impact   

 Dev Technology is supporting the operations, maintenance, and continued enhancement of a mission-essential platform in an environment built primarily on Microsoft Dynamics 365, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Platform Government, and Azure.   

 In this role, you will help configure, extend, troubleshoot, and improve Dynamics 365 and Power Platform capabilities that support case and matter management, reporting, dashboards, approval processes, knowledge management, and day-to-day user needs. You will partner closely with the client development and maintenance teams as well as the inhouse Helpdesk and Government users.   

 This role is designed for a hands-on Microsoft platform specialist who can move comfortably between configuration, development, troubleshooting, customer support, and release planning in a secure federal environment.   

 Dynamics 365 Delivery and User Support   

 This role blends Dynamics 365/Power Platform development with configuration and advanced user support. You will:   

 
 Configure and extend Dynamics 365 Online and Power Platform capabilities to meet evolving business requirements.   

 
 
 Develop and maintain reports, Advanced Find views, queries, dashboards, approval processes, and knowledge base/customer service portal capabilities.   

 
 
 Configure Dynamics CRM organizations and support release management, deployment, and troubleshooting for release-ready solutions.   

 
 
 Work directly with the client’s Tasking System users to provide technical assistance , configuration support, training, and solutions that may not require a formal release.   

 
 
 Partner with development and maintenance teams to identify recurring needs, inform future release features, and translate user issues into practical configuration or development changes.   

 
 
 Apply a user-first approach and sound UI/UX practices when developing or modifying user-facing capabilities, with a focus on usability, consistency, and user adoption.   

 
 You will remain close to both the platform and its users—troubleshooting issues, validating changes, supporting testing, maintaining documentation, and helping ensure Dynamics 365 capabilities remain secure, supportable, and aligned with the agency standards.   

 Who Thrives Here   

 People who thrive in this role bring strong Microsoft-platform expertise and a practical, customer-focused approach to delivery. They:   

 
 Enjoy solving business problems through a mix of configuration and code rather than defaulting to custom development.   

 
 
 Can explain Dynamics 365 and Power Platform capabilities clearly to technical and non-technical users.   

 
 
 Are comfortable investigating production issues, tracing root causes, and working across application, identity, integration, and data dependencies.   

 
 
 Value secure configuration, disciplined release practices, documentation, and repeatable support processes.   

 
 
 Can shift between planned enhancement work and responsive Tier III customer support.   

 
 
 Collaborate well with developers, helpdesk staff, Government stakeholders, and other Microsoft platform teams.   

 
 The Opportunity   

 This role offers the opportunity to support and enhance a mission-critical case management platform used across the client agency. You will influence both day-to-day user experience and the longer-term evolution of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform capabilities, from rapid configuration changes through formal releases and integrations.   

 Key Responsibilities   

 
 Configure, customize, maintain , and enhance Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions.   

 
 
 Extend Dynamics 365 functionality using approved technologies, including .NET Framework and JavaScript frameworks used within the client environment.   

 
 
 Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, queries, views, workflows/approval processes, and customer service or knowledge-management capabilities.   

 
 
 Provide dedicated Tier III Dynamics 365/Power Platform development and analyst support to the inhouse helpdesk and federal end users .   

 
 
 Configure Dynamics CRM organizations and support application release management, deployment, troubleshooting, and production readiness.   

 
 
 Integrate Dynamics 365 capabilities with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, identity services, Exchange Online, and other client systems as required .   

 
 
 Participate in unit, system, interoperability, regression, and user-focused testing before production deployment.   

 
 
 Support Agile development and CI/CD practices , including source/configuration management and controlled deployment of application changes using Government-provided tools such as Jira, GitHub Enterprise, and/or Azure DevOps Server .   

 
 
 Support access, permission, and configuration management activities while maintaining compliance with agency security and lifecycle standards.   

 
 
 Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, FAQs, procedures, and training materials.   

 
 
 Provide user training and support sessions and help identify opportunities for process, usability, and platform improvements.   

 
 Required Qualifications   

 
 Minimum of 4 years of relevant professional experience , including direct experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform.   

 
 
 Hands-on experience configuring, customizing, supporting, and troubleshooting Microsoft Dynamics 365 in an enterprise environment.   

 
 
 Experience with Microsoft Power Platform and development/configuration of business processes, reports, dashboards, views, queries, and approval workflows.   

 
 
 Experience extending Dynamics 365 using .NET Framework and JavaScript; familiarity with React and/or jQuery is relevant to the current technical stack.   

 
 
 Experience supporting application releases, deployment, testing, troubleshooting, and production support.   

 
 
 Ability to work with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, identity/authentication, and enterprise integration dependencies.   

 
 
 Experience producing clear technical/user documentation and working directly with end users to diagnose needs and provide training.   

 
 
 Working knowledge of Agile development, source control, and CI/CD practices .   

 
 Preferred Qualifications   

 
 Experience with Dynamics 365 Government / Power Platform Government or another regulated Microsoft cloud environment.   

 
 
 Experience supporting federal civilian or DHS systems and formal security/change-control processes.   

 
 
 Experience with Azure services, Entra ID, Microsoft Graph API, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions , or related Azure integration capabilities.   

 
 
 Experience with SharePoint integration, customer service portals, knowledge bases, and enterprise document-management workflows.   

 
 
 Familiarity with UI/UX and user-centered design principles for enterprise business applications.   

 
 
 Relevant , current Microsoft D ynamics 365, Power Platform, and/or Azure certifications .   

 
 Our estimated salary range for this position is $80,000 - 120,000, this presented salary range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Offered salary is based on experience, geographic location, and possibly contractual requirements as appropriate to the role. *Salary could fall outside of this range.  
 Who We Are 

 Dev Technology is a growing IT company with an employee-centric culture that works on mission-critical projects for the federal government. We partner with our federal customers to deliver technology services and solutions, and to drive our client’s missions forward through innovation. We use Agile and DevSecOps  principles to provide services including application development, biometrics and identity management, cloud and infrastructure optimization, IT and legacy modernization, and data management.     

 As a Washington Post Top Workplace award winner for the past THIRTEEN years in a row, the Top Workplaces USA for the past five years, and a recipient of the Companies As Responsive Employers (CARE) Award for the past six years, Dev Technology employees enjoy:    

 
 Generous and flexible time-off policy 

 Flexible work schedules and telework options, including remote work availability for eligible projects 

 Career development opportunities including a mentorship program, technical and management training through Dev University, hands-on learning through DevLab, tuition reimbursement, and paid training opportunities 

 Industry-leading benefits including a choice of two health plans that include dental and vision, flexible spending account, commuter benefits, life insurance, and more 

 401K matching with a 5% matching contribution 

 Regular team and company social events including our annual party, happy hours, fitness challenges, and more   

 A focus on community engagement including company wide support activities, employer match for donations, and time off for volunteer efforts 

 To learn more about working at Dev Technology, visit Working At Dev Technology Group 

 
  

 Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans 

 

  

  

  

  

 Dev Technology Group operates in the following states: AL, AR, AZ, CO, DC, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, MD, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NJ, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WV.
